motion.name: call-and-response
motion.value: reach 200px, ripple 320px/s, answer ±0.55s, swell up to 2.6x, ring Firefly White 12%
motion.purpose: Tap on the dark field: crowd dots within reach flash back nearest first; one fading hairline ring marks the call. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: field-sync
motion.value: gather 0.32 to 0.5; lit 0.4 to 0.52; Kuramoto coupling 0 to 2.4 over 0.58 to 0.86 (smoothstep)
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven story field; crowd dims 40% as the pod lights; max step 1/20 s; pixel ratio capped at 2; pauses off-screen and on tab hide.

motion.name: reduced-motion-field
motion.purpose: Hero draws the crowd only; the story draws its end state (pod gathered, lit, in step).

narrative.overview:
Firefly's world is a dark city with one light that answers you. Soft black runs edge to edge; strangers are warm firefly-white dots drifting and blinking on their own; the only bright thing in any composition is Glow. Over it sits a civic, almost municipal grotesk layer: very large, tight Host Grotesk in warm white, small two-line labels, hairline rules and solid square cells. Nothing is decorated. Hierarchy comes from size and from the muted-over-ink pairing, not from weight, colour or containers.

The interface has no blue (decided 2026-11-25). Black is the ground; every neutral is warm (ink, muted, rules and the crowd all sit near hue 105). Night and Wing survive only inside the logo files, and the mark keeps its own colours wherever it appears. The landing page (`src/features/landing/`) is always dark regardless of the visitor's setting, a confirmed exception. App screens will follow the system light/dark setting, but no light system has been built, so this file records no light-mode tokens; the root stylesheet's light defaults are placeholders.

Motion is two ideas, both drawn from real fireflies. Call and response: tap the dark and the nearby crowd flashes back in a ripple. Falling into step: on scroll, five strangers gather, turn Glow and synchronise (Kuramoto coupling). Everything else is near-still, and every motion has a still frame. There is no photography; example events and the example pod are synthetic and say so, and features that have not launched carry a "Coming next" label.
keyCharacteristics: Soft black ground edge to edge; warm neutrals only; no blue in the interface.
One Glow per composition, always solid.
Host Grotesk only, regular weight, tight negative tracking; size carries hierarchy.
Two-line labels: muted context line over the warm-white fact.
Hairline rules and square cells instead of cards, shadows or gradients.
Flat dots: a flash is size and opacity, never blur or bloom.
Phone first from 360px; everything readable with the motion switched off.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Each composition has exactly one Glow element. In the feed demo it is the best-fit dot; in the story it is the pod; in the invite section it is the submit block. The hero has none: it is the crowd alone. If a second Glow appears on screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No Blue Rule
rules.body: The interface has no blue. Grounds are black, neutrals are warm. Night and Wing exist only inside the mark, which keeps its own colours.

rules.name: The Solid Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow over black is drawn at full opacity; dimmed Glow turns olive. Lit pod dots flash by swelling, not fading.

rules.name: The No Glow on Paper Rule
rules.body: Glow never carries text or an essential indicator on a light surface; on light, the glow becomes Night (brand/README.md).

rules.name: The Size Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by size and by the muted/ink pairing. Display and headline stay at 400; nothing on the page is bold.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.01em at item and input, -0.02em at title, -0.03em at statement, -0.035em at headline, -0.04em at display.

rules.name: The Flat Dot Rule
rules.body: The flat dot is the light. Field dots, the best-fit dot, marquee separators and the mark are solid circles; a flash is shown by size and opacity, never by blur, bloom or glow.

dos: Do keep one Glow element per composition, at full opacity.
Do keep the interface blue-free: black grounds and warm neutrals; Night and Wing only inside the mark.
Do set display type in Host Grotesk 400 with negative tracking (-0.04em at display).
Do pair a Muted context line over an Ink fact for labels.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines at Ink 13%, and frame controls with Ink 28%.
Do keep header cells, chips, buttons and inputs square (0 radius).
Do give every motion a still version under reduced motion, and pause canvas loops when off-screen or the tab is hidden.
Do label example events and the example pod as made up, and unlaunched features as "Coming next".
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, blur, bloom or glows to dots, the mark or surfaces.
Don't use bold weights for hierarchy; use size.
Don't wrap content in cards; the drawn phone is the one framed object.
Don't use Night, Wing or any blue as an interface fill, text or rule colour.
Don't put Glow text or essential Glow indicators on a light surface.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; Host Grotesk is self-hosted.
Don't invent light-mode tokens from the landing page; the light system is unbuilt.
